summary:
Iter 14 (MapLibre premium map + card verification enforcement + premium vehicle picker + login/onboarding link updates) — FULL PASS. Backend 59/59 tests green (8 new iter14 + 26 iter13 regression + 25 iter10 regression, 36.6s). All new backend behaviour verified: (1) GET /api/payment-methods returns 'verified' boolean on every method; legacy records without the field default to true. (2) POST /api/trips/request returns 402 with detail 'Legg til et betalingskort før du bestiller tur' when user has no card; 402 with 'Kortet ditt må verifiseres før du kan bestille tur' when all methods have verified=False; 200 when at least one method has verified=true or missing (legacy). (3) /api/superadmin/fleet-applications still 403 for regular user, 200 for superadmin. Stripe SetupIntent status flow reviewed statically — server.py:927-984 correctly sets verified=(setup_status=='succeeded'), stores verified on new record and updates it on repeat calls; cannot end-to-end test without real Stripe session but code path is sound.

Frontend (mobile 390x844, live URL): PremiumMap (MapLibre GL JS) renders on /app Home — canvas 390x764, primary OpenFreeMap Liberty style timed out under 4s so Voyager raster fallback kicked in as designed; map is visible with correct tiles behind the booking sheet. data-testid='home-map' present. Vehicle picker redesign works: horizontal snap-scroll, all 4 cards present (vehicle-ai-first, vehicle-enkelt, vehicle-trygg, vehicle-premium) with unique SVG glyphs, tagline chips (RASK/SPAR/FAMILIE/SIGNATURE), capacity icons, tabular price. Selected state clearly shown as brass gradient + brass border + brass checkmark badge top-right (verified visually on Premium selection). Payment row states verified end-to-end: (a) verified default card → green 'VERIFISERT' pill + Bestill enabled with 'Bestill nå · X kr'; (b) all cards verified=false via mongo → booking-verify-card row appears ('Kortet må verifiseres · Fullfør 3D-Secure på kortet før første tur') + Bestill disabled with label 'Verifiser kortet for å bestille'. BookingFlow /app/booking/{tripId} — MapLibre canvas fills viewport (390x844), 0-height bug FIXED (inline height:100dvh + PremiumMap position:absolute inset:0). Onboarding footer: onboarding-driver-link + onboarding-loyver-link present. Login: login-demo-fill button autofills ola@kjapp.no/test1234 correctly; link-loyver-apply present with href=/apply/fleet ('Bli løyvehaver'); existing Sjåfør link preserved. DriverHome polish confirmed — toggle uses theme rgba(white) not old #17222a/#263038; mint accent preserved. No emojis on customer side (regex scan clean). Zero page errors, zero console errors on Home + BookingFlow flows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now at 2609 lines — monolith continues to grow. Refactor into routers/ modules is overdue (payment_methods.py, trips.py, stripe_setup.py) as flagged in iter10/11/12/13.

Home.jsx hasVerifiedPaymentMethod is computed as ANY method verified — not the DEFAULT method specifically. This means: if user has a verified Vipps but unverified Visa (their default), the UI still shows 'VERIFISERT' green pill for the default Visa card. Consider gating on defaultMethod.verified specifically so the pill accurately reflects the actually-used card. (Not a blocker — backend gate uses same 'any verified' logic so booking still succeeds, but UX is misleading.)

PremiumMap sets a 4s hard fallback timer BUT never checks whether primary style eventually loaded successfully — if it loads at 5s the swap has already happened. In our testing this was fine (primary timed out and fallback engaged). Consider clearing the timeout in map.on('load').

PremiumMap.jsx line 261 dependency array uses `cars` (array reference) — will trigger re-render on every parent-side polling refresh even when values are equal. Consider stringifying or shallow-diffing car positions.
The 402 error detail messages are user-facing strings hardcoded in Norwegian at server.py:681/684 — fine for KJAPP but should be moved to a shared i18n dict if English/other locales are added.

PremiumMap keeps its own useEffect updating a marker's inner .car-rotate transform via imperative DOM query — works but is fragile. Consider re-creating the marker element on bearing change or using MapLibre's setRotation on symbol layer instead.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of iter14 UI checks (map render, vehicle picker, payment row 3 states, booking flow map, driver polish, login demo-fill, onboarding+login links)

seed_data_creation: During tests: mongo direct manipulation of ola's payment_methods (set verified=False on all, then $unset to restore). All new payment_methods created in tests are prefixed TEST_ and cleaned up in fixtures. iter13 tests also created ~4 TEST_ fleet applications + drivers (already cleaned up per iter13 fixtures).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 14 is stable. Key notes for future testing: (1) ola@kjapp.no accumulates stale trips easily — always cancel active trips via db.trips.updateMany({user_id: OLA_ID, status: {$nin:['completed','cancelled']}}, {$set:{status:'cancelled'}}) before running Home UI tests, else user is taken straight to 'Søker sjåfør' screen and can't see vehicle picker. (2) Vehicle picker only appears after selecting a destination (click 'Hvor skal du?' → click a favorite like 'Aker Brygge'). It does NOT show on initial home load. (3) MapLibre primary style (OpenFreeMap Liberty) often times out under 4s in this preview environment — the raster Voyager fallback IS working and produces a fully usable map; this is BY DESIGN. (4) The UI VERIFISERT pill reflects hasVerifiedPaymentMethod globally not defaultMethod.verified — see code review comment. (5) To trigger unverified UI state: `db.payment_methods.updateMany({user_id: OLA_ID}, {$set:{verified: false}})` — restoring via $unset or $set:true both work.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Everything the review_request asked for is implemented and verified.
